reason: I buy my panels and batteries by walking the market and haggling shop by shop, and my electrician wires it for me. A company sending me a written offer through an app will give me their asking price, and in the souq I always get it lower than the first number.
objection: These listed companies will quote high because they know they are competing on an app, and I cannot see whether the ratings are real or from their own friends. Also, if I go through them I lose my own electrician, who I trust.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that the app prices are really lower than what I find in the market for the same brands, for example a neighbour who used it and paid less, or being able to get parts prices only and use my own electrician.
